about: What an office fit-out is and how it differs from renovation

A fit-out is the preparation of a rented space for a specific company. A business centre usually hands over the space as shell & core (concrete, base services on the floor) or white box (walls, ceiling and floor ready for finishing). Our task is to turn it into a working office: place people and meeting rooms, distribute services, install partitions and furniture.

A fit-out differs from a regular office renovation in that many decisions are dictated by the building: the landlord's technical conditions, permissible loads, connection points for ventilation and electrics, hours for noisy works. We prepare drawings to these requirements; the approval itself follows the building's rules and the lease, terms individual.

Office renovation from $350/m²: works and rough materials. Design project from $30/m², minimum $2,500. Furniture, equipment, cabling hardware and finishing materials are separate, per estimate; furniture and lighting can be brought directly from China.
We invoice companies registered in Ukraine, and the timeline is fixed in the contract. A completed example is Office Chicago.

What is the difference between shell & core and white box?

Shell & core is a space without finishes or internal services, only the floor's base engineering. White box already has walls, ceiling and floor ready for finishing. The scope and cost depend on the condition of the space.
Do you handle approvals with the business centre?
We prepare drawings and documents to the building's technical requirements and schedule the works to its rules. Approval follows the landlord's procedure; terms individual.
